import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_scope.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_copy.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/screen_layout.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/kind_art.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/data/models/app_settings.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// Step 4: explain reminders before the system prompt.
class PreAskPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const PreAskPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    final catalog = AppScope.of(context).catalog;
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        final kindId = state.selected.isEmpty
            ? catalog.kind.first.id
            : state.selected.first;
        final itemName = state.names[kindId] ?? 'Your item';
        final time = AppCopy.time(state.time);
        return Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
              child: KitTopBar(
                onBack: () => bloc.add(const BackPressed()),
                center: const KitProgressDots(step: 4, count: 4),
                trailingSpace: true,
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: PinnedBottomColumn(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  KitSpace.l,
                  14,
                  KitSpace.l,
                  KitSpace.xl,
                ),
                bottom: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Your phone will ask you to confirm next.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: KitType.captionLarge.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.xs),
                    KitButton(
                      label: 'Turn on reminders',
                      icon: KitIcons.bell,
                      loading: state.busy,
                      onPressed: () => bloc.add(const RemindersAccepted()),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    KitButton(
                      label: 'Not now',
                      variant: KitButtonVariant.ghost,
                      onPressed: state.busy
                          ? null
                          : () => bloc.add(const RemindersDeclined()),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                children: [
                  SizedBox(
                    height: 300,
                    child: LayoutBuilder(
                      builder: (context, box) => OverflowBox(
                        maxWidth: box.maxWidth + 8,
                        child: Container(
                          width: box.maxWidth + 8,
                          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: c.lilac,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(KitRadius.xl),
                          ),
                          child: Stack(
                            children: [
                              Positioned(
                                left: 12,
                                bottom: -8,
                                width: 168,
                                height: 196,
                                child: KindArt(
                                  kind: catalog.byId(kindId),
                                  progress: 0.5,
                                  cheerTick: state.grantedTick,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Positioned(
                                right: 16,
                                top: 38,
                                width: 272,
                                child: KitNotificationPreview(
                                  appName: 'Sample',
                                  time: time,
                                  title: '$itemName needs a look',
                                  body: AppCopy.reminderBody(
                                    1,
                                    AmountUnit.cups,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 28),
                  Semantics(
                    header: true,
                    child: KitBalancedText(
                      'Want a reminder?',
                      style: KitType.title.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(
                    'One reminder on due days at $time. No promos, and '
                    'nothing on other days.',
                    style: KitType.body.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
